goal: Rehab & return-to-run foundation → Barcelona Marathon (Mar 2027, sub-2:50 / London GFA)

days.name: Gym legs A + elbow
days.description: Ankle & Hips program (Yasmin). Full leg-strength session plus daily elbow set.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.how_to: Controlled, full range. Progress load only when all sets are clean.

exercises.name: Calf press (gastrocnemius)
exercises.how_to: Slow lower, full stretch at the bottom, drive through the ball of the foot.

exercises.name: Single-leg seated calf raise
exercises.how_to: On the leg-extension machine. Pause 1s at the top, slow lower.

exercises.name: Cable hip abduction
exercises.how_to: Stand tall, drive the leg out and slightly back, no torso lean.

exercises.name: Seated hamstring curl
exercises.how_to: Squeeze and hold at full flexion, control the return.

exercises.name: Single-leg leg extension
exercises.how_to: Alternate legs, controlled tempo, no swinging.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat (Smith)
exercises.how_to: Rear foot elevated, drop straight down, front knee tracks over the toes.

exercises.name: Lunge heel-raise isometric hold
exercises.how_to: Split stance, raise onto the ball of the front foot and hold — isometric calf/Achilles load.

exercises.name: Pogo hops
exercises.how_to: Stiff ankles, minimal knee bend, bounce off the balls of the feet — fast ground contact.

exercises.name: Single-leg calf hop
exercises.how_to: Small hops, land soft and spring straight back up.

exercises.name: Elbow rehab (daily)
exercises.detail: Wrist flexion (dumbbell) · wrist extension (weight) · forearm supination/pronation — ~1–2 × 15 each
exercises.how_to: From Yasmin's program. Slow tempo, keep pain ≤3/10. Plus ibuprofen gel for the first 2 weeks. Golfer's-elbow tendinopathy — daily consistency matters more than load.

days.name: Iso + elbow (home)
days.description: Home isometric tendon work (lunge heel-raise iso hold) plus daily elbow set. Plyos are done as run-day warm-ups (per Yasmin), not here.

exercises.name: Lunge heel-raise isometric hold
exercises.how_to: From Yasmin's program. Split stance, raise onto the ball of the front foot and hold — sustained calf/Achilles tendon load. This is the key rehab stimulus of the session.

exercises.name: Elbow
exercises.how_to: Do the elbow set today too.

exercises.name: Elbow rehab (daily)
exercises.detail: Wrist flexion (dumbbell) · wrist extension (weight) · forearm supination/pronation — ~1–2 × 15 each
exercises.how_to: From Yasmin's program. Slow tempo, keep pain ≤3/10. Plus ibuprofen gel for the first 2 weeks. Golfer's-elbow tendinopathy — daily consistency matters more than load.

days.name: Easy run (+ plyo warm-up) + elbow
days.description: Plyo warm-up, then 6 km easy. Plus daily elbow set.

exercises.name: Plyo warm-up (before the run)
exercises.detail: Pogo hops 2–3 × 20 · single-leg calf hop 2 × 20 each
exercises.how_to: Yasmin: do the home plyos (pogo hops + calf hop, from the Ankle & Hips program) as a warm-up on run days. Stiff, springy ankles, quiet landings — primes the calf/Achilles, then run.

exercises.name: Easy run
exercises.how_to: Fully conversational, HR < 145. Rebuilding — keep it genuinely easy. Cut it short if the calf tightens.

exercises.name: Elbow rehab (daily)
exercises.detail: Wrist flexion (dumbbell) · wrist extension (weight) · forearm supination/pronation — ~1–2 × 15 each
exercises.how_to: From Yasmin's program. Slow tempo, keep pain ≤3/10. Plus ibuprofen gel for the first 2 weeks. Golfer's-elbow tendinopathy — daily consistency matters more than load.

exercises.how_to: Yasmin: do the home plyos (pogo hops + calf hop, from the Ankle & Hips program) as a warm-up on run days. Stiff, springy ankles, quiet landings — primes the calf/Achilles, then run.

exercises.name: Easy run
exercises.how_to: Fully conversational, HR < 145. Rebuilding — keep it genuinely easy. Cut it short if the calf tightens.

exercises.name: Elbow rehab (daily)
exercises.detail: Wrist flexion (dumbbell) · wrist extension (weight) · forearm supination/pronation — ~1–2 × 15 each
exercises.how_to: From Yasmin's program. Slow tempo, keep pain ≤3/10. Plus ibuprofen gel for the first 2 weeks. Golfer's-elbow tendinopathy — daily consistency matters more than load.

days.name: Gym legs B + elbow

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.how_to: Controlled, full range. Progress load only when all sets are clean.

exercises.name: Calf press (gastrocnemius)
exercises.how_to: Slow lower, full stretch at the bottom, drive through the ball of the foot.

exercises.name: Single-leg seated calf raise
exercises.how_to: On the leg-extension machine. Pause 1s at the top, slow lower.

exercises.name: Cable hip abduction
exercises.how_to: Stand tall, drive the leg out and slightly back, no torso lean.

exercises.name: Seated hamstring curl
exercises.how_to: Squeeze and hold at full flexion, control the return.

exercises.name: Single-leg leg extension
exercises.how_to: Alternate legs, controlled tempo, no swinging.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat (Smith)
exercises.how_to: Rear foot elevated, drop straight down, front knee tracks over the toes.

exercises.name: Lunge heel-raise isometric hold
exercises.how_to: Split stance, raise onto the ball of the front foot and hold — isometric calf/Achilles load.

exercises.name: Pogo hops

exercises.how_to: From Yasmin's program. Slow tempo, keep pain ≤3/10. Plus ibuprofen gel for the first 2 weeks. Golfer's-elbow tendinopathy — daily consistency matters more than load.

days.name: Iso + elbow (home)
days.description: Home isometric tendon work (lunge heel-raise iso hold) plus daily elbow set. Or rest/tennis if the week is loaded.

exercises.name: Lunge heel-raise isometric hold
exercises.how_to: From Yasmin's program. Split stance, raise onto the ball of the front foot and hold — sustained calf/Achilles tendon load. This is the key rehab stimulus of the session.

days.name: Long run (+ plyo warm-up) + elbow
days.description: Plyo warm-up, then 18 km easy long run — the week's key durability session. Plus daily elbow set.

exercises.name: Plyo warm-up (before the run)
exercises.detail: Pogo hops 2–3 × 20 · single-leg calf hop 2 × 20 each
exercises.how_to: Yasmin: do the home plyos (pogo hops + calf hop, from the Ankle & Hips program) as a warm-up on run days. Stiff, springy ankles, quiet landings — primes the calf/Achilles, then run.

exercises.name: Long run
exercises.how_to: Steady and relaxed — the week's key durability session. Walk-jog the last km rather than pushing through calf tightness.

days.name: Gym legs A + elbow
days.description: Ankle & Hips program (Yasmin). Full leg-strength session plus daily elbow set.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.how_to: Controlled, full range. Progress load only when all sets are clean.

exercises.name: Calf press (gastrocnemius)
exercises.how_to: Slow lower, full stretch at the bottom, drive through the ball of the foot.

exercises.name: Single-leg seated calf raise
exercises.how_to: On the leg-extension machine. Pause 1s at the top, slow lower.

exercises.name: Cable hip abduction
exercises.how_to: Stand tall, drive the leg out and slightly back, no torso lean.

exercises.name: Seated hamstring curl
exercises.how_to: Squeeze and hold at full flexion, control the return.

exercises.name: Single-leg leg extension
exercises.how_to: Alternate legs, controlled tempo, no swinging.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat (Smith)
exercises.how_to: Rear foot elevated, drop straight down, front knee tracks over the toes.

exercises.name: Lunge heel-raise isometric hold
exercises.how_to: Split stance, raise onto the ball of the front foot and hold — isometric calf/Achilles load.

exercises.name: Pogo hops
exercises.how_to: Stiff ankles, minimal knee bend, bounce off the balls of the feet — fast ground contact.

exercises.name: Single-leg calf hop
exercises.how_to: Small hops, land soft and spring straight back up.
